system.description: Blue-skinned humanoids from the once idyllic world of Terellia, the local Terrelian Jango Jumpers were long ago conquered for use as gladiators. Many can be found as slaves throughout The Outer Rim, in gladiator pits, or eking out a meager existence in the cracks and hollows of society. Natural athletes, it isn't uncommon for a Terrelian to be mistaken as Force-sensitive. Their long limbs and compact muscles allow the Species to leap great distances and sprint for extended periods of time.
